_about: Public-domain Daniel Parish Kidder (1815-1891), Methodist missionary to Brazil, Sunday-school editor and seminary professor at Garrett and Drew, for the Word Hoard: Mormonism and the Mormons, Sketches of Residence and Travels in Brazil, A Treatise on Homiletics, and The Christian Pastorate. The many Sunday-school books he only edited are left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 105 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

kidder-mormonism: Mormonism and the Mormons (New York : G. Lane & P. P. Sandford, 1842)
kidder-brazil-sketches: Sketches of residence and travels in Brazil, embracing historical and geographical notices of the empire and its several provinces, vol. 1 (Philadelphia, Sorin & Ball; London, Wiley & Putnam, 1845)
kidder-homiletics: A treatise on homiletics : designed to illustrate the true theory and practice of preaching the gospel (New York : Phillips & Hunt ; Cincinnati : Walden & Stowe, 1864)
kidder-christian-pastorate: The Christian pastorate : its character, responsibilities, and duties (Cincinnati : Hitchcock and Walden ; New York : Nelson and Phillips, 1871)

_excluded.kidder-edited: Sunday-school books he edited for the Methodist Sunday School Union (other authors)
_excluded.kidder-brazil-brazilians: Brazil and the Brazilians (written with J. C. Fletcher)

kidder-mormonism.ia_possible_copyright_status: The Library of Congress is unaware of any copyright restrictions for this item.
